confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Swedish and Nordic pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and are bounded from the beer relationship; hostel and hotel rates are the least certain because they vary strongly by season and event demand, and July is a busy summer period in Gothenburg. FX observation was taken from RBA-sourced search summaries for the 2026-10-15 F11 figure, not from a downloaded table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Swedish and Nordic pricing, with Gothenburg set somewhat below Stockholm and in the range of other mid-sized Scandinavian cities; restaurant and accommodation levels were bounded against that Nordic basis. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the local beer price.
